title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for T2DM.

HPI
Pt is a 76 y.o. female presenting for routine management of type 2 diabetes. Pt reports feeling well and denies any acute concerns or symptoms today. She has been on her current oral hypoglycemic for several years. She reports consistent adherence to her medication regimen. No reports of tremors, sweating, or dizziness.

Medication List
Metformin 500mg BID.

Exam
Gen: Alert and oriented x3. CTAB.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F.
Physical: No acute distress. Skin intact. WNL.

Assessment
1. T2DM without complications.

Plan
1. Continue current dose of metformin.
2. Routine labs ordered to monitor A1c and renal function.
3. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, PA-C
05/14/2026
explanations: No complication is documented: type 2 diabetes without complications.
Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

distractors.why: Nothing in the note documents hyperglycemia or poor control.
Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.
